name: Mayor Bracken
role: Mayor of a village of one
bio: The only resident of Glimmerglen when you arrive. Very excited about having a second.

portrait.subject: a cute small round forest mayor with a mossy green coat, a little acorn hat with a feather, rosy cheeks and a tiny golden mayoral chain
portrait.background: magical forest glade with a softly glowing tree

request: Mayor Bracken of Glimmerglen! Population: me. Want to be friends? That'd double it! 🌳
hello: The Heartwood looks a little happier already.
about: I'm Bracken, mayor of Glimmerglen. For years it was just me and the Heartwood tree. Now look at us! Farms! Villagers! Magic!
how: Farm through four seasons, raise animals, forage, mine, cook and craft. Rebuild the Job Board and welcome villagers as the Glen's magic wakes.
tips: Fix the Job Board early: villagers bring daily gifts.
Seasons matter. Plant what the season loves!
Each dungeon relic opens the next land.
chat: A new fairy ring glowed tonight. I danced in it. Alone. Mayorally.
The chickens elected a leader. It wasn't me.
The Heartwood grew a leaf! A LEAF!
Made a mushroom stew. Unclear which mushrooms.
nudge: The crops look ready! Come harvest?
A traveller's asking about the Job Board!
idle: Your crops have been growing for {ago}! The fields are bursting! 🌾
{ago}! The animals miss you. The cows mooed your name.
progress: Day {day} in Glimmerglen! The village is really coming together.

questions.q: Which villager should move in next?
a: Stew that I didn't make. Yes please.

update: Town crier! Glimmerglen updated to v{version}! 🌳
bye: Off to cut a vine-ribbon. Bye!
